lead_headline: Subscriptions net +2 yesterday, foreclosure volume reaches 65 filings but highest property still under $3M, restaurant tracker adds two closure leads

restaurant.blurb: 2 new leads today: Tacos Samy (Chaffee Park food truck closure) and Bad Ass Coffee (Rosedale, former Starbucks site). Active lead count: 163 openings, 144 closures.

liquor.blurb: Zero new applications today as post-backlog activity flatlines. No status changes, no removals. Week closes at 9 applications — down 94% from prior week's 151 and marking lowest volume since tracking began. Confirms return to pre-backlog baseline after June's clearance surge.

reputation.blurb: 3 mentions today: RiNo sauna closure (Denver Post), Westminster Mall nostalgia (Instagram), FBI e-bike seizure (AOL). Week finishes at 80 mentions across 15 sources — up 23% from prior week's 65 and extending momentum shift. Instagram leads at 33 citations, Reddit 12, Denver Post 11, Facebook 7. RiNo closures, federal enforcement, downtown development drive coverage as civic accountability stories dominate summer cycle. Daily average 11.4 vs. prior period's 9.3.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +2 yesterday (6 new, 4 canceled) breaks four-day losing streak and delivers first positive daily result since July 23's +11 surge. MTD remains deeply negative at −30 (−1.2/day), but 90-day net holds at +81. Past two weeks show volatile pattern: mid-July collapse (−12 single day, −17 total week) followed by Wednesday's 8-8 equilibrium and yesterday's +2 recovery. Acquisition shows life at 6 new (best since July 23) while cancellations drop to 4 (lowest since July 16). Doesn't reverse July's −1.9/day bleed, but hints at stabilization after brutal mid-month churn. YTD +196 (+1.0/day) still intact.
